name: Pull-Up
cues: Set the assistance to zero or step off the pad and hang from the handles;Pull the chest toward the handles, lower to straight arms

name: Chin-Up
cues: Palms facing you, shoulder-width grip, assistance at zero;Pull the chin over the handles, lower to straight arms

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
cues: Use parallel handles if the machine has them;Pull until the hands are beside the chest

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
cues: Hands wider than the shoulders, assistance at zero;Pull the elbows down and back

name: Negative Pull-Up
cues: Step to the top position, then lower for 3-5 seconds;Reset by stepping up, do not jump up

name: Scapular Pull-Up
cues: Hang with straight arms, assistance at zero;Pull the shoulder blades down without bending the elbows

name: Parallel-Bar Dip
cues: Assistance at zero, lock the elbows at the top;Lower until the upper arms are parallel to the floor

name: Pistol Squat
cues: Stand on one leg, extend the other forward;Sit back and down under control, then stand

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench, one foot flat, other leg held up;Drive the hips up and pause

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
cues: Whole foot on the box, dumbbells at the sides;Drive up through the front heel and lower under control

name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge
cues: Step forward and lower the back knee toward the floor;Push back to the start

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Rear foot on the bench, dumbbells at the sides;Lower straight down with the front foot flat
